title: Grateful Dead Live at Oregon Country Fair on 1982-08-28
lineage: Cassette  (Nakamichi DR-1) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/96k) -> Adobe Audition v3.0 -> Samplitude Professional v11.03 -> FLAC/16

ai_review.summary: A clean, high‑energy outdoor show with first‑time performances of “Day Job” and “West LA Fadeaway”, captured in an unknown source that sounds generally listenable.
ai_review.review: The concert is praised for its strong vocals from Jerry, sizzling keyboards by Brent, and memorable moments like the debut of “Day Job” and “West LA Fadeaway”.  Reviewers describe a hot‑sun, dusty field vibe but still call the show fun and musically solid.  No concrete details about the recording source are given, though the performance comes across as clear enough to enjoy.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers rate the show highly (5, 4, 4) and highlight strong performances; recording quality is not discussed, so rating leans on musical merit with moderate confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No reviewer comments about soundboard, audience bleed, or clarity; presumed adequate but unverified.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Fans note a solid song selection with several first‑time performances and strong vocal delivery, despite the show being cut short by dust.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Strong vocals noted; voice sounded recovered after tour break.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent (keyboard) was sizzling throughout the set.
